title: The MAHARASHTRA WATER CONSERVATION CORPORATION ACT, 2000.
full_text: The MAHARASHTRA WATER CONSERVATION CORPORATION ACT, 2000. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 20013 Act Number: 3 Enactment Date: 2001-01-02 Act Year: 2001 Short Title: The MAHARASHTRA WATER CONSERVATION CORPORATION ACT, 2000. Long Title: An Act to make special provisions for promotion, operation and rapid development and regulation of watershed and water conservation works, including social forestry and irrigation projects in the State of Maharashtra by establishing the Water Conservation Corporation.
